en-US.description:
Seven spins, sixty years of pro football, one shot at an undefeated season.

Each spin hands you one franchise and one era. Take a player, fill a slot, and live with it. Seven picks decide your season — no simulation, no luck after the whistle.

Three ways to play. Rookie shows you every rating. Scout gives you the stat line and no grade. GM Mode gives you a name and a year, and nothing else.

Every rating is computed from what actually happened, against the era it happened in. 17-0 lands about once every 6,000 games.
en-US.promotionalText: Each spin hands you one franchise and one era. Seven picks decide a season, rated against the era it was played in. 17-0 lands about once every 6,000 games.

Every line must be true of the TV build: no tapping, no sharing, no sign-in (the TV plays signed out). Broadcast mode and sound shipped in #78.

en-US.description:
Seven spins, sixty years of pro football, one shot at an undefeated season — on the biggest screen in the house.

Each spin hands you one franchise and one era. Take a player, fill a slot, and live with it. Seven picks decide your season — no simulation, no luck after the whistle.

Built for the couch. Play the whole game with the Siri Remote: the field sits beside the player list, every pick is a click, and the record lands full-screen for the room to argue about.

Three ways to play. Rookie shows you every rating. Scout gives you the stat line and no grade. GM Mode gives you a name and a year, and nothing else.

Broadcast mode turns the screen into a sports-show graphics package for podcasts and streams: a scorebug with every pick, lower-thirds for each spin and player, a ticker, a full-screen record reveal with the 17-0 verdict, and a live fair-or-off tally for Gut Check. Original sound effects score the spin, the lock-in and the reveal, and switch off in a click.

Gut Check: ten real seasons, one rating each. Swipe right if it's fair, left if it's off. Pass the remote around and see who agrees with the model.

Every rating is computed from what actually happened, against the era it happened in. 17-0 lands about once every 6,000 games.
en-US.promotionalText: Seven spins, one shot at an undefeated season, from the couch. Broadcast mode adds a scorebug, lower-thirds and a big record reveal for podcasts.

_ageRatingComment: The questionnaire, from docs/submission.md. Enum fields take NONE / INFREQUENT_OR_MILD / FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE / INFREQUENT / FREQUENT; the rest are booleans. userGeneratedContent is the only yes, and it is the display name -- filtered when chosen and reportable by anyone. kidsAgeBand is deliberately absent: this is not a Kids Category app, and setting it opts into rules that are much stricter than the game needs.
